plan.summary: This 1-4 block is an off-camp boxing build with Week 1 used to establish baseline performance on the main bodyweight strength patterns, then Weeks 2-3 build force, power, and repeatable conditioning, and Week 4 deloads volume while keeping speed and quality high. The full 12-week cycle raises your force ceiling first, then intensifies it, then expresses it with sharper sport-relevant power and speed. Main program loading starts in Week 2 after Week 1 baseline assessments.

phaseOverview.label: Building
phaseOverview.focus: Build bodyweight strength, jumping power, trunk strength, and aerobic repeatability without forcing a speed peak.

phaseOverview.label: Intensifying
phaseOverview.focus: Progress harder unilateral strength, faster ballistic output, and denser conditioning while keeping recovery manageable.

phaseOverview.label: Expressing
phaseOverview.focus: Keep strength in place and express it through sharper jumps, throws-style ballistic intent, and faster boxing-specific conditioning.

exercises.name: 1. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Warm up with easy sets, then perform one hard clean set to establish your baseline. Full range, body straight, and stop before form breaks.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then perform one hard top set of push-ups with clean form, stopping with about 1 rep left. Log total reps so future progress can be tracked.

performanceTarget.prompt: Beat your best clean rep set over time without losing range or body position.

substitutionOptions.name: Hands-Elevated Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if floor push-ups are too limited to give a clean hard set.

exercises.name: 2. Squat Jump
exercises.notes: Reset between reps and jump as fast as possible. Land softly and keep each rep crisp.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if squat jumps bother the knees or if you move better with a dip.

exercises.name: 3a. Pike Push-Up
exercises.notes: Control the lower, press smoothly, and stop around RPE 7-8.

substitutionOptions.name: Wall Lean Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the pike position is too aggressive on shoulders or wrists.

exercises.name: 3b. Hollow Body Hold
exercises.notes: Keep low back lightly pressed down and ribs tucked. Stop before shaking turns the position sloppy.

substitutionOptions.name: Dead Bug
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you cannot hold a clean hollow position.

exercises.name: 4. Tempo Shadow Boxing
exercises.notes: Easy aerobic flush. Stay relaxed and nasal-breathe when possible.

endurancePrescription.work: 2 minutes smooth shadow boxing

exercises.name: 1. Rear-Foot-Elevated Split Squat
exercises.reps: 6-12 each side leaving 1 rep in reserve
exercises.notes: Warm up with a few easy reps, then perform one hard clean set per side to establish your baseline. Use full control and keep the front foot flat.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then perform one hard top set per side with bodyweight only, stopping with about 1 rep left. Log reps per side for future progress tracking.

performanceTarget.prompt: Build cleaner reps and more reps per side over time before making the variation harder.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if rear-foot elevation setup is awkward or balance is limiting the set.

exercises.name: 2. Broad Jump
exercises.notes: Stick each landing and reset fully. Chase distance with clean positions, not sloppy reach.

substitutionOptions.name: Countermovement Jump
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if space is limited.

exercises.name: 3a. Single-Leg Hip Thrust
exercises.notes: Drive through the heel and pause briefly at the top. Stop around RPE 7-8.

substitutionOptions.name: Glute Bridge
substitutionOptions.notes: Use bilateral reps if single-leg work cramps or feels unstable.

exercises.name: 3b. Side Plank
exercises.notes: Keep hips stacked and body straight. Do not let the top shoulder roll forward.

substitutionOptions.name: Bent-Knee Side Plank
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the full side plank breaks down too early.

exercises.name: 4. Tempo Intervals
exercises.notes: Stay smooth, rhythmic, and conversational. This is conditioning support, not a hard finish.

endurancePrescription.work: 30 seconds fast feet in place

exercises.name: 1. Towel Row Isometric
exercises.notes: Anchor the towel securely, lean back, and row hard into the hold to establish your baseline. Keep shoulders down and chest tall.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then perform one hard timed hold with a secure towel setup. Log the best clean hold time to track pulling strength.

performanceTarget.prompt: Build a longer strong hold without shrugging or losing body position.

substitutionOptions.name: Table Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you have a sturdy table and it is safer than a towel setup.

exercises.name: 2. Plyometric Push-Up
exercises.notes: Explode off the floor with fast hands. Use low contacts and stop if speed drops.

substitutionOptions.name: Fast Push-Up
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a fast non-airborne version if impact bothers the wrists.

exercises.name: 3a. Towel Row
exercises.notes: Use a secure setup and pull elbows toward the ribs. Stop around RPE 7-8 with clean body line.

substitutionOptions.name: Table Row
substitutionOptions.notes: Often easier to load and coach if a sturdy table is available.

exercises.name: 3b. Reverse Crunch
exercises.notes: Curl the pelvis up under control. Avoid swinging the legs.

substitutionOptions.name: Strict Leg Raise
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this only if you can keep the lower back controlled.

exercises.name: 4. Shadow Boxing Aerobic Rounds
exercises.notes: Keep the shoulders loose and rhythm consistent. Smooth output only.

endurancePrescription.work: 2 minutes light shadow boxing with footwork

exercises.name: 1. Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift
exercises.reps: 8-12 each side leaving 1 rep in reserve
exercises.notes: Warm up with easy balance reps, then perform one hard clean set per side to establish your baseline. Reach long, keep the hips square, and move under control.

strengthAssessment.prompt: Warm up progressively, then perform one hard top set per side with bodyweight only, stopping with about 1 rep left. Log reps per side for future progress tracking.

performanceTarget.prompt: Own balance and range first, then build reps per side.

substitutionOptions.name: Kickstand Romanian Deadlift
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if balance is the main limiter.

exercises.name: 2. Skater Jump
exercises.notes: Cover ground laterally and stick the landing briefly. Keep the torso controlled.

substitutionOptions.name: Lateral Bound to Stick
substitutionOptions.notes: Use a smaller jump distance if control is poor.

exercises.name: 3a. Step-Up
exercises.notes: Use a stable surface only. Drive through the whole foot and control the descent at RPE 7-8.

substitutionOptions.name: Split Squat
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if you do not have a safe step height.

exercises.name: 3b. Bear Plank Shoulder Tap
exercises.notes: Move slowly enough to avoid hip sway. Keep knees low and ribs tucked.

substitutionOptions.name: High Plank Shoulder Tap
substitutionOptions.notes: Use this if the bear position is too demanding.

exercises.name: 4. Tempo Intervals
exercises.notes: Stay springy and relaxed. This should help work capacity without leaving you flat.

endurancePrescription.work: 20 seconds line stepovers or fast feet

exercises.name: 1. Pogo Jump
exercises.notes: Quick contacts, tall posture, and low amplitude. Keep the ankles springy, not heavy.

substitutionOptions.name: Line Hops
substitutionOptions.notes: Use if pogos feel better in a smaller range.

exercises.name: 2a. Push-Up
exercises.notes: Clean easy reps only at RPE 6-7. Save energy and move well.

exercises.name: 2b. Towel Row
exercises.notes: Smooth controlled reps at RPE 6-7. Use a secure setup and stop well before form slips.

exercises.name: 3. Dead Bug
exercises.notes: Exhale fully as each leg reaches. Keep low back stable the whole time.

exercises.name: 4. Aerobic Shadow Boxing
exercises.notes: Relaxed rhythm, easy movement, and smooth breathing. Finish feeling better than when you started.

endurancePrescription.work: Continuous easy shadow boxing and footwork
endurancePrescription.rest: As needed to keep effort easy
